about: Magnitude response of FM9 firmware-12 DynaCab placements (Cab block in DYNA-CAB mode, slot 2 muted), in tenths of a dB relative to its own mean, at 'frequencies'. Measured on an FM9 (2026-10-14) the same way as fm9-12-cab-curves.json, against the same baseline. 'position' is the Dyna Cab setting (0-10), 'distanceCm' the Distance setting in centimetres.
